jobs.title: Product Manager, Developer Platform
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Globex Labs

Globex Labs makes AI tools for engineering teams. A fictional company for the LVLme demo.

About the role

Own the developer platform roadmap.

What you'll do

  • Talk to developers every week
  • Write clear product specs

What you'll bring

  • 5+ years of product management on developer tools
  • A record of shipping platform products

Nice to have

  • Experience with AI developer tools

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager, Infrastructure
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Globex Labs

Globex Labs makes AI tools for engineering teams. A fictional company for the LVLme demo.

About the role

Run the programs that keep our compute fleet growing.

What you'll do

  • Plan capacity programs with infrastructure teams
  • Track vendor deliveries

What you'll bring

  • 6+ years of technical program management in infrastructure or operations
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent experience

Nice to have

  • Experience with hardware supply chains

jobs.title: Trust and Safety Operations Lead
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Globex Labs

Globex Labs makes AI tools for engineering teams. A fictional company for the LVLme demo.

About the role

Lead the team that reviews reports of misuse.

What you'll do

  • Run the review queue and its quality checks
  • Improve escalation playbooks

What you'll bring

  • 3+ years leading trust and safety or content moderation operations

Nice to have

  • Experience writing enforcement guidelines
